questions: Do all three operations incur the same cost, or are there different costs for each operation type?
Is the cost per operation a fixed constant (e.g., 1) or can it vary per operation index?
Are we allowed to output any sequence of operations that minimizes total cost, or must we output exactly one specific format (e.g., lexicographically smallest)?
When performing Operation 2, does it set x_j = 1 only for j outside [L_i, R_i], leaving indices inside unchanged, or does it also potentially set inside indices to 0?
Is the sequence x updated immediately after each operation, affecting subsequent operations, or are all operations applied simultaneously to the initial state?
Can we choose different operations for different i independently, or must we choose the same operation type for all i?
If the goal is achievable, must we output exactly M operations (one per given pair), or can we output fewer (e.g., skip some operations by choosing 'do nothing')?
Are there any constraints on the cost values beyond being non-negative integers, or are they always 1?
